{{Quote|Valarian has been bringing in off-world specialists to try to compete with my organization.|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />}}
'''Emanon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] in the employ of [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Valarian has assembled a team in a pathetic attempt to mount various attacks against me. They have set up strategic command at a secure outpost, but I have discovered the location of that bunker. You shall infiltrate this bunker and take out Valarian's team.|Jabba the Hutt, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Emanon was part of a group of 'outside help' hired by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]] to act as her command staff in raids against her rival, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He, along with the rest of the group; [[Iris Tanada Sinclair]], [[Fnast Drexler]], [[Arkahn Greystar]] and [[Careem]], setup headquarters in the [[Valarian Strategic Command Bunker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where they were guarded by a large number of Valarian's guards and Blood Vandals. From this bunker they launched and coordinated their attacks on Jabba. He was eventually killed along with all of the other commanders by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] hired by Jabba to stop the raids.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Emanon was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Emanon was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> One of the missions from Jabba himself asked the player to kill Tyrok.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />
